name: HCL Technologies
summary: Historical FY2025 evidence: 4.7% constant-currency revenue growth and 18.3% operating margin were within the original annual guidance bands. Services and software had different growth rates.

findings.title: Original annual growth and margin bands were met
findings.body: The April 2024 call guided to FY2025 revenue growth of 3–5% in constant currency and an 18–19% operating margin. The April 2025 call reported 4.7% and 18.3%, respectively.

findings.title: Services and software grew at different rates
findings.body: Management reported FY2025 Services growth of 4.8% in constant currency and HCLSoftware growth of 3.5%. Software annual recurring revenue was US$1.03 billion.

findings.title: Annual report provides a separate cash check
findings.body: The FY2025 annual report records operating cash flow of US$2.6 billion and free cash flow of US$2.5 billion. These are reported company measures, not forecasts.

commitments.statement: On 26 April 2024, management set its original FY2025 revenue outlook.
commitments.target: 3–5% year-on-year growth in constant currency; FY2025
commitments.observed: 4.7% year-on-year growth in constant currency; FY2025
commitments.reason: The annual company growth outcome was inside the original band. Acquisitions are included; this is not an organic-growth comparison.

commitments.statement: On 26 April 2024, management set an annual operating margin range.
commitments.reason: The reported annual outcome was inside the original range.

sources.title: Q4 FY2024 earnings call · 26 April 2024

sources.excerpt: In FY25, we reported a consolidated revenue of $13.84 billion, an increase of 4.7% in constant currency.
